source.verticalDatum: Not stated by the public terrain tileset; use relative terrain contact, not an assumed absolute orthometric datum.
source.nativeResolution: Adaptive simplified triangles; resampling to2m does not establish2m source accuracy.

reference.basis: Mapped western historic-body approach at native x-54. Published terrain supplies the height;8.05m original reconstructed deck control supplies model contact. Bridge-contact differences depend on host terrain resolution.

reconstruction.bankTops: Original photo-scaled rock/support base profile; outside shoulders meet the published relative height field. These are reconstruction, not measured rock shapes.
